project_at_sigma.returns: J_red(σ) per prime channel, as complex values

moments.returns: dict with M₀..M₃ and the per-channel L₀..L₃ at σ = ½

taylor_coefficients.returns: dict with the derived coefficients c1 and c3

params.sigmas: σ values to compare at; None uses a default grid

verify_against_actual.returns: dict with the predicted and actual values and their residuals
